# JUDO Operation Utils

> Runtime utility library providing the abstract base class, container system, collection operations, and three-valued boolean logic that all JUDO-generated operation scripts depend on.

Key facts:
- Java 21, single-module Maven project (OSGi bundle packaging)
- Build with Maven Wrapper: `./mvnw clean install`
- Core dependency of JUDO generated scripts — not used directly by applications
- Built on Eclipse EMF (Ecore), judo-meta-asm (Architecture Specific Model), judo-dao-api, judo-dispatcher-api
- Key components: `AbstractGeneratedScript`, `Container`, `FunctionRunner`, `Kleene`
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Source

- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/operation/utils/AbstractGeneratedScript.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/operation/utils/AbstractGeneratedScript.java): Core base class for generated scripts — implements `Function<Payload, Payload>`, manages Container lifecycle, CRUD, query execution, and coercion
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/operation/utils/FunctionRunner.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/operation/utils/FunctionRunner.java): Collection and query utilities — filter, sort, head/tail, aggregations, string operations, actor/principal lookup
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/operation/utils/Kleene.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/operation/utils/Kleene.java): Three-valued (null-safe) boolean logic — and, or, xor, implies, not per strong Kleene semantics

## Depends on

- [judo-meta-asm](../../models/judo-meta-asm): ASM metamodel — Ecore-based architecture model with builders and validation
- [judo-dao-api](../judo-dao-api): Core DAO interfaces for CRUD, query, navigation, and validation
- [judo-dispatcher-api](../judo-dispatcher-api): Dispatcher API contracts for routing API calls to runtime actions

## Used by

- [judo-tatami](../judo-tatami): Model transformation pipeline — ESM/PSM to deployable application artifacts
- [judo-tatami-base](../judo-tatami-base): PSM transformation pipeline — models to schemas, expressions, and configurations
- [judo-tatami-jsl](../judo-tatami-jsl): JSL-to-runtime model transformation engine (PSM, ASM, UI, RDBMS, etc.)
